panels.description: Mera uses an old mechanical key to open a wet underground passage with no active control nodes. Keep upper passage clear.
The group enters a damaged monitoring station with water stains, obsolete equipment and no Alpha display. Keep upper station clear.
B11's shoulder projector activates while an identical projector wakes across the station. Keep upper projection fields clear.
Adrian's equation appears on both projections above the wet equipment. Keep upper projection clear.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: He left this where Alpha couldn’t count it.
